hypotheses.representation_type: univariate q-quotient with geometric-sum and sine specializations
hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: G0002 is F(z) directly. G0001 is the finite geometric sum in z that evaluates to F(z) under t=z. G0003 is F(t) specialized to t=exp(I*theta), using Euler's formula to identify F(exp(I*theta)) with sin((m+1)*theta)/sin(theta).
hypotheses.rationale: G0001 is a geometric series with ratio z**(-2); summing it gives exactly the two-term quotient G0002. G0002 has the same algebraic form as the sine ratio G0003 under the standard substitution z=exp(I*theta). The common latent object F(t) captures this quotient structure for all three catalog members.
